scope: Human gate review of zero-based rows 190 through 284 inclusive of the capped Erdős resolved-theorem candidate queue.

nonacceptance.pending_reason: Problem 43 part ii is attributed only to a live Barreto comment; no fixed proof artifact or publication for the exact asymptotic statement was located.

method.statement_review: Compared every pinned natural-language block and exact formal type for polarity, quantifiers, domain, and scope.
method.status_review: Checked the pinned teorth status record for every row and the live numbered Erdős pages during this review; exact subclaims were separated from broad parent status.
method.resolution_review: Retrieved numbered pages/bibliographies and fixed MR, arXiv, PDF, gist, or git-commit evidence. Material fixed Lean surfaces and their sorry/axiom boundaries were inspected.
method.importance_review: Required a nontrivial numbered-problem resolution or separately sourced research theorem; explicitly easy identities, trivial obstructions, and unsourced support observations were rejected.
method.dedupe_review: Compared statements within rows 190--284 and against accepted rows 0--189; denied double credit to semantic equivalents, direct same-proof weakenings, wrappers, and the Problem 618/134 cross-slice duplicate.
method.rights_review: Emitted metadata, hashes, locators, and original assessments only; no third-party paper text or source docstring is copied into the review.

scope_boundaries.row_193: Exact M ≥ 1 FC-shaped Problem 42 theorem is supported by a fixed axiom-audited proof.
scope_boundaries.row_194: Uses the documented frequently-in-n reading of the displayed ≫ claim.
scope_boundaries.row_235: Small-dimensional Borsuk theorem is accepted independently of the disproved broad parent.
scope_boundaries.row_251: Rejected because its K3 natural-language conclusion conflicts with the arbitrary-m formal type.
scope_boundaries.row_266: Accepts only the eventual large-n formulation.
scope_boundaries.row_280: Accepts only eventual nonempty pairs as k varies, not infinite pairs for fixed k.

validation.authority_preimage_format: ASCII source_sha256, review_sha256, ordered_stage_claim_ids_sha256, and ordered_identity_payload_sha256_values_sha256 separated by one space and terminated by LF
